summary: Improve property-offer controls, investor onboarding, and platform reporting. Explore this practical five-day real estate crowdfunding course.
lede: Property crowdfunding training helps platform operations, investment and compliance professionals manage digital property offers and investor servicing. Participants practise mapping platform and SPV responsibilities, assessing offer readiness, checking investor eligibility and onboarding evidence, reconciling subscriptions and payments, and maintaining distribution records and operating KPI reports through documented workflows.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who manage the operating details behind property crowdfunding offers, from deal intake and investor onboarding through payment reconciliation and reporting.
audience: Real Estate Crowdfunding Platform Operations Analysts
modules: Platform KPI Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate investment transactions, investor administration, or digital financial services is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based records and workflow maps.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
